reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent you the list in this DM.

1. #PD-4492: Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025. The gatehouse kiosk at the Eau Claire yard wasn't sending SMS bay assignments to drivers on the 04:00 shift at Doors 14–18. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that the next 04:00 shift got through the gate without help. There was also a follow-up to archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct maintenance window.
   Source: "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth", teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md

2. #4419: Thea logged this one because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It went to tier-2 product support for firmware testing.
   Source: "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)", teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md

Two other Moss notes mention Quarrendon but give no ticket number: the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in. The Central handoffs digest has #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those belong to Marrow accounts, not Quarrendon. Also, Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" is about a different company that isn't a customer, so keep it out of the list.

Before this goes in the weekly notes:
- I only checked Moss's notes that you have access to, so there may be more ticket numbers elsewhere.
- The cheat sheet has no date, so check whether #4419 is still open.
